04. Scrum roles, events and
artifacts

SIMPLE ENGLISH
Scrum is a lightweight framework with Product Owner, Scrum Master and Developers; a
Sprint contains Planning, Daily Scrum, Review and Retrospective. Artifacts are Product
Backlog, Sprint Backlog and Increment, with Product Goal, Sprint Goal and Definition of
Done commitments.

Product Goal: easier checkout
Sprint Goal: save a cart
Definition of Done: reviewed, tested, integrated

Expected result: The team inspects the increment and adapts its work; the DoD is shared quality
criteria.

Q: What is the difference between Review and Retrospective?
A: Review inspects product outcomes with stakeholders; Retrospective improves the team's way
of working.
